meta.name: Hundred Hindi Hotstar Special 1080p
meta.description: Two women with different demons and life expectations cross paths only to make quirky team. With their dreams at stake and their clock ticking away, will this roller-coaster ride get them what they want...

videos.title: Ab Judge Karo Mujhe
videos.overview: Netra’s dull life as a government employee gets rocked by unsettling news. On the other hand, ACP Saumya is desperate to break the glass ceiling. What happens when the two cross paths?

videos.title: Hawa Hawai
videos.overview: On Saumya's advice, Netra decides to take charge of her life. Meanwhile, Saumya tries to catch organ traders defying her husband and boss who plan the course of her career.

videos.title: Chance Pe Dance
videos.overview: A ridiculous assignment from DCP Anshuman and Netra's greed put Saumya's plan to resurrect her career in jeopardy and the stakes get higher!

videos.title: Meri Blacklist
videos.overview: Inches away from glory, Saumya saves Netra's life but cuts all ties with her. Later, Netra finds that Aniket gambled away her Switzerland dreams, while Saumya gets a lead on a drug deal.

videos.title: Disco Deewane
videos.overview: Saumya wins accolades from the minister, leaving Pravin burning with jealousy. Elsewhere, Netra lands at Shantanu's house to close the deal where an unexpected situation awaits her.

videos.title: Chor Aur Chowkidaar
videos.overview: As Netra checks another wish off her bucket list, Saumya discovers a startling fact about the former. Later, a Venezuelan minister’s visit opens a can of worms for the duo.

videos.title: Main Bhi Item Girl
videos.overview: Netra alters her to-do list to help a friend and Saumya strikes a deal with Mule. While Saumya chases a Venezuelan minister, Pravin orders his team to spy on her.

videos.title: Khel Khiladi Ka
videos.overview: Netra realises her love for Shantanu whereas Pravin confronts Saumya about Maddy. But Saumya will do anything for a win. In this powerplay, who will be the winner?
